devdoc.details: Non-custodial VTX vesting for team, advisors, and early contributors.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

addBeneficiary(address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Callable only before TGE; registered allocation totals cannot exceed the contract VTX balance.

params.beneficiary: Address that can claim vested VTX.
params.cliff: Duration in seconds after TGE before vesting begins.
params.total: Total VTX allocation assigned to the beneficiary.
params.vesting: Duration in seconds over which tokens vest linearly after the cliff.

claimVested().details: Uses checks-effects-interactions and SafeERC20 transfer semantics.

claimableAmount(address).details: Claimable VTX is vested-to-date minus the amount already claimed.

params.beneficiary: Address whose claimable amount will be calculated.

returns.amount: Net VTX available to claim now.

initialize(address,uint256).details: This function is callable once by the owner and requires a future TGE.

params.tgeTimestamp_: Unix timestamp at which vesting schedules begin.
params.token_: Address of the VTX ERC-20 token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

revokeBeneficiary(address).details: Vested but unclaimed VTX is paid first; unvested VTX is returned to the owner.

params.beneficiary: Address of the registered beneficiary to revoke.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

vestedAmount(address).details: Revoked schedules stop accruing at their revocation timestamp.

params.beneficiary: Address whose vested amount will be calculated.

returns.amount: Cumulative vested VTX before subtracting prior claims.

initialize(address,uint256).notice: Configures the VTX token and Token Generation Event timestamp.
